tests.title: Compatibility aggregate projections update from latest successful Security scan and preserve SBOM canonical immutability
tests.description: Verifies latest successful Security scan counts update SBOMManifest/ArtifactSBOM compatibility fields without publishing or mutating canonical SBOM events, and fallback behavior remains available when no Security scan exists.
preconditions: Security persistence and SBOM compatibility projections are implemented.
steps: Seed an SBOM manifest/projection with existing aggregate counts and no Security scan.
Assert policy/UI compatibility consumers can still read fallback counts.
Persist a successful Security scan with severity counts for the same target.
Project compatibility counts and assert canonical SBOM event references remain unchanged.
tests.expected_result: Compatibility projections reflect latest successful Security counts when present, fall back when absent, and never mutate canonical SBOM 30078/30004 events.
mocks: Repository fixtures for SBOM manifest and Security scan state
data_requirements: Stable SBOM subject, payload hash, run id, and severity counts
determinism_notes: Repository state is seeded directly; no relay or OSV network calls are required.

known_gaps: Epic 5 owns full release quality gates and broad documentation; remaining implementation/review work is tracked in Beads.
